content.reference_answer: A strong answer records the starting state, applies exactly one transition at a time, and connects the second state to the invariant described in the lesson.

title: Diagnose and fix
prompt_markdown: A solution using Sliding Window works on the sample but fails on an empty input or a tie. Explain the likely missing condition and propose a focused test.
hints: Do not rewrite everything; isolate the violated assumption.

rubric: Includes a test with expected behavior
content.reference_answer: Handle the boundary explicitly, then add the smallest input that previously failed and assert its exact result. The precise condition depends on the implementation, but the reasoning must connect the failure to its invariant.

title: Write a focused Python code

content.reference_answer: Answers may vary. The implementation must satisfy the stated contract, make the lesson's key invariant visible, and include a boundary test or concurrency consideration.

title: Interview explanation
prompt_markdown: Give a concise interview explanation of Sliding Window: mental model, one trade-off, one common mistake, and one test.

content.reference_answer: A complete answer defines the mechanism, names when it is appropriate, identifies a failure mode, and gives a test that would reveal that failure.
